modalLead: Widgets fold away like the categories beside them, and a site that asks you to sign in is no longer reported as a page that has vanished.

items.text: A widget folds away like a category. Several widgets on one page put the block you wanted below the fold. Click a widget's title to fold it shut, or press Enter with it focused — the same gesture a category has always had, on the same header. Fold all and the . key take widgets with them, and each stays as you left it.

A site behind a login is not a page that vanished. With Spot pages that answer 200 but say "not found" switched on, bookmarks pointing at an app that asks you to sign in — a media server, a container manager, anything on your own network — were reported down with Page says it does not exist while the site was perfectly up. They read as healthy again, and a page that really is gone is still caught.
